patterns.name: keyword.control.header.ears

patterns.name: keyword.control.clause.ears

patterns.name: keyword.operator.logical.ears
patterns.match: \b(and|AND|or|OR|not|NOT|in|is|empty|non-empty|some|none|forall|exists|within|of|as|from|with)\b|(且|或|不满足|属于|不为|为|非空|空|有值|无值|所有|存在|在时间窗内|距|作为|来自|携带)

patterns.name: support.function.action.ears
